## Checklist

- [ ] Added or updated `registry/<your-addon-id>.json` pointing to a public GitHub repository and exact 40-character `commit` SHA
- [ ] `addon.json` uses my own `id` (not `app.koona.*` or `*.example.*`) and `author.name`
- [ ] `LICENSE.md` is at the add-on's root with the year and copyright holder filled in, matching `license` in `addon.json`
- [ ] The add-on's folder contains only `.lua`, `.json`, and `.md` files (no `.gitignore`, `.github`, or images)
- [ ] Tested locally in Koona Books by loading the folder and running each feature
